title: Epikloop cost row
description: One line of ~/.epikloop/projects/<id>/cost.jsonl per closed story. Written by the emitter, never by the model; the instrument for tuning effort levels.

ts.description: When the story closed, by the emitter's clock (ISO 8601 UTC).

wall.description: Wall-clock seconds, from the emitter's own clock.

cost.description: USD when a source reports it; null otherwise. Never a placeholder 0.

model.description: Model id when reported; null otherwise.
